machineTrack: ROUND 10b (2026-09-01): the msvcp140 C++ iostream layer landed (host_shims_msvcp.c: streambuf/basic_ios/istream/ostream/iostream members on the real MSVC x86 layout, 54 imports; abi-notes output/decomp/_scratch/msvcp140/abi-notes.md; host selftest 103->127, mutation-checked via mutate.mjs). Landing it exposed and fixed a GENERAL baked-purge bug: the lifter bakes each host-import call's stack purge INTO THE CALLER at lift time (`s->ESP += 4u + <purge>u`), and gen_shims.py's push-count sweep miscounted five __thiscall ctors (basic_ios() as 32, should be 0; iostream 8->4, ostream 12->8, _Lockit 36->4, widen 12->4), so the lifted std::stringstream ctor over-popped and mis-passed args (sb==1). Fixed WITHOUT a full re-lift: scripts/recomp/lift/lift_patches.py PURGE_PATCHES rewrites the baked constant per call site (12 sites) and drops the touched TU's object; build_boot.py recompiles only those. RULE: when you correct a purge in gen_shims.py, add its (wrong,right) to PURGE_PATCHES; `python scripts/recomp/lift/lift_patches.py --dir output/recomp/lift/gu --check` lists stale sites. NEXT UNIT (lifter side): boot now faults just after the first operator>>(istream&,string&) returns, in tokenizer 0x0067f420 at 0x0040cf50, because operator>> restored esi from a slot 4 bytes off. The game calls rdbuf->_Lock()/_Unlock() through the stringbuf vtable slots, which hold TAIL-JUMP thunks 0x00aef06b/0x00aef071 (jmp [msvcp import]); the lifter models the indirect call-into-thunk and the thunk's jmp-to-shim as two return-consuming steps whose ESP adjustments don't net to one call/ret. Fix: lift `jmp [import]` thunks as transparent tail calls (no extra pop) or route through isaac_indirect_call once. _Fiopen + codecvt facets (behind fstream ctor 0x009e8010) stay loud stubs.
